about.description: Brent crude oil perpetual market. The contract tracks Brent, the main international crude benchmark, using a futures-based reference price with scheduled contract rolls. Users get linear oil price exposure only, without owning physical crude, inventory claims, or a deliverable futures position. Pricing uses a futures-based external reference with scheduled contract rolls. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
